questions.stem: A first-order reaction has a half-life of $10\ \text{min}$. Find the time, in minutes, needed for $75\%$ of the reactant to be consumed.
questions.solution:
**Key idea:** for first order, each half-life halves what remains.

1. 100% → 50% after 1 half-life
2. 50% → 25% remaining (75% consumed) after 2 half-lives
3. **$t = 20\ \text{min}$**
hints: 75% consumed means 25% remains. How many halvings is that?
